subject: EOD settlement stuck - but ticket INC-00015 said this was fixed yesterday
description: End of day settlement is failing again on Terminal 1. System hangs at 98% completion every time we try to close out. However, we were told by support yesterday (INC-00015) that the OrbitPOS v2.1 update resolved all EOD issues and the terminal was working perfectly. Terminal is currently functional for transactions but refuses to settle. Please advise - this contradicts the resolution from yesterday.
